# Worldant Project

This is a generated Worldant world.

Read the canonical Worldant AI docs before changing generated structure or adding application code:

- https://github.com/Midwess/worldant/blob/main/ai/worldant.llms.txt
- https://github.com/Midwess/worldant/blob/main/ai/llms-full.txt

Human docs:

- https://github.com/Midwess/worldant/tree/main/docs/worldant

Current Worldant model:

- Command: immediate, non-durable application function under `commands/`.
- Workflow: durable deterministic orchestration under `workflows/`.
- Step: internal Workflow IO checkpoint under `workflows/steps/`, never public.

Rules:

- Do not create `queries/`, `mutations/`, `reactive/`, `goals.ts`, generic Actions, or public Step
  APIs.
- Commands import supported capabilities from `worldant`.
- Standalone Command database calls commit independently. Use `db.transaction(async (tx) => ...)`
  when multiple Command database effects must commit together.
- Workflow bodies must stay deterministic. Put database and other supported IO in Steps.
- Worldant does not define users, JWT formats, claims, tenants, roles, or token validation.
- Application authorization is normal PostgreSQL row-level security in migrations.
- Request-bound application SQL can read custom headers from
  `current_setting('request.headers', true)::jsonb`.
- Do not trust raw client headers in production unless a trusted gateway, middleware, or SQL
  function has validated them.
